say:1:1721938001:1.text: You've got everything? Good. Then listen carefully.
say:1:1721938001:1.source_cn: 东西都准备好了？很好。现在听我指挥。

say:2:1721938002:1.text: Mage, your job's easy. When the time comes, put those three trinkets into the water nice and gently. No splashing, no fumbling. Do it like you're making an offering to a queen.
say:2:1721938002:1.source_cn: 魔法师，你的任务很简单。把这三样东西，轻柔地丢进水里。...
say:2:1721938002:1.male: Mage, your job's easy. When the time comes, put those three trinkets into the water nice and gently. No splashing, no fumbling. Do it like you're making an offering to a queen.
say:2:1721938002:1.female: Mage, your job's easy. When the time comes, put those three trinkets into the water nice and gently. No splashing, no fumbling. Do it like you're making an offering to a queen.

say:3:1721938003:1.text: And you, Aiden, stay back and play that happy little song you wrote for Pearl. Put some feeling into it this time. I want energy. I want warmth.
say:3:1721938003:1.source_cn: 至于你，阿德里安。你就站在后面，用你最大的力气、最饱满...

say:4:1721938004:1.text: And make it sound happy! If I hear even a trace of that sad little whiny tone, I'll claw your face off!
say:4:1721938004:1.source_cn: 记住，要快乐！如果让我听到一丝哭腔，我就把你挠成花脸！

say:6:1721938006:1.text: And one instrument won't be enough. Mage, when the song really gets going, you join in too. Sing, use magic, clap—whatever works. I want the whole river to feel it!
say:6:1721938006:1.source_cn: 还有，光靠一把琴可能不够热闹。魔法师，等他弹到高潮的时...
say:6:1721938006:1.male: And one instrument won't be enough. Mage, when the song really gets going, you join in too. Sing, use magic, clap—whatever works. I want the whole river to feel it!
say:6:1721938006:1.female: And one instrument won't be enough. Mage, when the song really gets going, you join in too. Sing, use magic, clap—whatever works. I want the whole river to feel it!

say:7:1721938007:1.text: I'll be up front waiting for her. And until I say so, neither of you comes any closer while Pearl and I have our private... no, intimate conversation. Got it?
say:7:1721938007:1.source_cn: 我会在最前面等着。记住，在我允许之前，谁也不许上前打扰...

choice_prompt:8:1721938007.text: I'll be up front waiting for her. And until I say so, neither of you comes any closer while Pearl and I have our private... no, intimate conversation. Got it?
choice_prompt:8:1721938007.source_cn: 我会在最前面等着。记住，在我允许之前，谁也不许上前打扰我和珍珠的私人……不，私密谈话。懂了吗？

say:9:1721938008:0.text: Good. Then let's get started. Make this a concert she won't forget!
say:9:1721938008:0.source_cn: 很好。行动开始！让这场愉快的黄昏音乐会，开演吧！
